LinkedIn Post Preview

Preview exactly how your text will look as a realistic LinkedIn post before you publish.

0 characters

Preview

📖 How to use

  1. Type your post text exactly as you would publish it.
  2. Add your name, headline and an optional image.
  3. See the realistic LinkedIn mock with the see-more fold marked.
  4. Copy the text and paste it into LinkedIn to publish.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the preview work?

Type your post text, pick an optional image and name/headline, and the tool renders a LinkedIn-style post mock with realistic chrome.

Does it post to LinkedIn?

No — this is a visual mock only. Copy the text and paste it into LinkedIn to publish for real.

Where is the 'see more' fold?

LinkedIn collapses long posts behind '…see more' — the preview shows where the fold happens (~210 characters).

Are my line breaks kept?

Line breaks you type are preserved in the preview, so you can design your hook and spacing.
